title: A Statistical Inference Framework for PMI Estimation and SGNS Word Embeddings
summary: Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) is a core measure of testing word association, and Skip-gram with Negative Sampling (SGNS) is essentially a method that implicitly factorizes a shifted PMI matrix. However, a systematic and well-rounded characterization of finite-sample uncertainty in PMI estimation remains absent and imperative to venture into. We provide a statistical framework for PMI estimation and its connection to SGNS.
